Quantitative tracks: scored intervals from a data.frame, GRanges or UCSCData

Source: R/tracks.R
QuantitativeTrack-class.Rd

QuantitativeTrack adds y-axis scaling to Track; it carries no data, so build tracks with its subclasses: DataFrameQuantitativeTrack (a data.frame of chrom, start, end, value in bedGraph coordinates), GRangesQuantitativeTrack (a GRanges with exactly one numeric metadata column) and UCSCBedGraphQuantitativeTrack (an rtracklayer UCSCData imported from bedGraph, needs the suggested package rtracklayer). Display one with loadTrack, which also sends visibilityWindow to igv.js.

Usage

QuantitativeTrack(
  trackName,
  quantitativeData,
  fileFormat = c("wig", "bigWig", "bedGraph", "gwas"),
  color = "gray",
  sourceType = c("file", "url"),
  trackHeight = 50,
  autoscale = TRUE,
  min = NA_real_,
  max = NA_real_,
  visibilityWindow = 1e+05
)

DataFrameQuantitativeTrack(
  trackName,
  quantitativeData,
  color = "blue",
  trackHeight = 50,
  autoscale,
  min = NA_real_,
  max = NA_real_,
  visibilityWindow = 1e+05
)

GRangesQuantitativeTrack(
  trackName,
  quantitativeData,
  color = "blue",
  trackHeight = 50,
  autoscale = TRUE,
  min = NA_real_,
  max = NA_real_,
  visibilityWindow = 1e+05
)

UCSCBedGraphQuantitativeTrack(
  trackName,
  quantitativeData,
  color = "blue",
  trackHeight = 50,
  autoscale = TRUE,
  min = NA_real_,
  max = NA_real_,
  visibilityWindow = 1e+05
)

Arguments

trackName

A character string, used as track label by igv; we recommend unique names per track

quantitativeData

the scored intervals; ignored by QuantitativeTrack, which only builds the shared part

fileFormat

One of "wig", "bigWig", "bedGraph", "gwas"

color

A CSS color name (e.g., "red" or "#FF0000"), or "random"

sourceType

"file" or "url"

trackHeight

track height in pixels

autoscale

Autoscale track to maximum value in view

min

Sets the minimum value for the data (y-axis) scale

max

Sets the maximum value for the data (y-axis) scale; ignored if autoscale is TRUE

visibilityWindow

Maximum window size in base pairs for which data is displayed

Value

An object of the named class

Slots

autoscale

logical, scale the track to the maximum value in view

min

numeric, y-axis minimum, used when autoscale is FALSE

max

numeric, y-axis maximum, used when autoscale is FALSE

coreObject

the scores: data.frame, GRanges or UCSCData

Examples

tbl <- data.frame(chrom = "chr1", start = c(100, 200), end = c(200, 300),
                  value = c(0.5, 2), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
track <- DataFrameQuantitativeTrack("bedGraph demo", tbl, autoscale = TRUE)
gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(c("chr1:101-200", "chr1:201-300"),
                             score = c(0.5, 2))
track2 <- GRangesQuantitativeTrack("GRanges demo", gr)
trackSize(track2)
#> [1] 2
